% Test fixture: an appendix with NO bibliography at all.
% Regression fixture. build.sh must not hand "latexpand --expand-bbl" a .bbl that was
% never produced, and the release must not abort on a document that cites nothing.
\documentclass[11pt]{article}
\usepackage[utf8]{inputenc}
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}

\title{Appendix Without a Bibliography}
\author{Fixture Author}
\date{}

\begin{document}
\maketitle

\section{Tables}
This document has no \verb|\cite| commands and no \verb|\bibliography| command,
so bibtex produces no .bbl file for it.

\begin{tabular}{ll}
  Key & Value \\
  \hline
  alpha & 1 \\
  beta & 2 \\
\end{tabular}

\end{document}
